audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Darius owned levels 1, 2, 4-5, first item and 2+ items (8/10, 7.5/10, 6.5/10, 6/10, 6/10) while every line of prose on the same page said the opposite: 'Kennen bullies your early levels', 'Kennen kites you all lane', 'Level 6 his R and stun chain punish your commits, favouring Kennen', 'Late it's a coin-flip'. The chart rows were the generic Darius template ('Hemorrhage passive bleed completely overwhelms raw early base stats'), not this matchup.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken is 950 range and Apprehend is 535, so a melee Darius cannot contest level 1. The page's own diff is TRICKY at 7/10 with a 7.5/10 carry rating, which a chart owned by Darius at every stage flatly contradicts. The prose-implied chart is Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill and that is what the packet's levelChart reads as well.
audit.corrected: Whole chart flipped as one group: win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side/.rating set to Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill with inverse ratings 3/3.5/5/4/4/5/5. Every phases[].why rewritten to match. Note: champ-data/kennen.full.js carries the identical wrong chart from the other side and needs the inverse flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike and phase text referenced 'his E cooldown' and 'Lightning Rush's cooldown' with no duration anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s and Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s. By rank 5 he dashes almost three times per Apprehend, which is exactly why the lane never becomes comfortable. Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s and costs no energy.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why, phases[3].why, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[9].t and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the real durations.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t was the 'Track Kennen's Lightning Rush' stub, and nothing on the page explained how the stun actually works - dontsFull[1].t said 'Get triple-stunned' but its description was boilerplate about your own committal tool.
audit.why: Mark of the Storm stuns only on the third application, and Thundering Shuriken, Electrical Surge and Lightning Rush each apply one - so the stun is countable, not random. Electrical Surge also applies on-hit every few attacks, which is why his damage is magic and scales with attack speed.
audit.corrected: report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d rewritten around the three-mark rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Boots were Plated Steelcaps against a champion whose entire kit is magic damage.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken, Electrical Surge, Lightning Rush and Slicing Maelstrom are all magic; Kennen deals no meaningful physical damage. Mercury's Treads also cut the Mark of the Storm stun via tenacity.

edits.before: Hemorrhage passive bleed completely overwhelms raw early base stats in any standing fight. Trade on his last-hits but don't chase past the wave.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken pokes from 950 while Apprehend reaches 535 — he chips you for free and you cannot answer. Last-hit, and never chase past the wave.

edits.before: Access to Crippling Strike (W) auto-attack reset provides immense localized burst punishes. Hold it for a guaranteed pull; a whiffed Apprehend is a free lane for Kennen.
edits.after: Crippling Strike gives you the auto reset, but Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 and walks straight through you. Hold Apprehend for a guaranteed pull, never a hopeful one.

edits.before: Full basic kits unlocked on both sides; spacing out displacements determines the winner. Keep the wave near your tower so Kennen has to walk into pull range.
edits.after: Both kits are out and the lane becomes one question: does Apprehend land through Lightning Rush? Keep the wave near your tower so Kennen has to walk into pull range.

edits.before: Optimal lane control window for Darius to establish strict minion freezes. Track Lightning Rush before you commit the pull.
edits.after: Lightning Rush falls to 6s at rank 5 while Apprehend is still 18.5s — he out-cycles your only engage. Bait the dash before you pull.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s and free to cast, and three Marks of the Storm stun you mid-combo — his ult plus the stun chain beats a fresh Guillotine unless the pull lands first.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness — the run-down you couldn't finish before is now lethal. Force fights on Lightning Rush's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker fixes your stickiness and the run-down finally finishes — but only if Apprehend connects. Force fights while Lightning Rush is down.

edits.before: You stay a side-lane terror but fall off vs grouped teams. Look for flank pulls in fights; one reset chain can win the game.
edits.after: A coin-flip on your E: catch him and the Guillotine chain ends it, whiff and his poke plus mobility whittle you out of the fight.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. Punish the cooldown. Engage only while it is down.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you. Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1, only 6s at rank 5.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Mark of the Storm stuns on the third application, and Q, W and E each apply one — count them, don't guess.

edits.before: His escape. Punish the cooldown. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken is 950 range on 7s — sidestep it; his escape is 10s.

edits.before: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush — commit the full combo immediately.
edits.after: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush — you have 10 seconds, commit now.

edits.before: Commit on Lightning Rush's cooldown, on your level-6 spike, and on your first-item timing. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit inside Lightning Rush's 10-second window, with Apprehend up, and on your first-item timing. Make him flinch first.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Stridebreaker (the stickiness fix), then Sterak's Gage / Dead Man's Plate; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Stridebreaker (the stickiness fix), then Sterak's Gage; Kennen is all magic, so boots are Mercury's Treads.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. Punish the cooldown. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.
edits.after: - Lightning Rush: 10s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 5 — matchup-defining, because Apprehend is 26s down to 16s and he simply dashes more often than you can pull. - Thundering Shuriken: 7s at rank 1, 950 range; sidestep it and his poke pattern dies. - Slicing Maelstrom: flat 120s and free to cast. - Ghost: your lethal enabler, saved for the one window his E is down.

notes: The level chart here was flipped in full: it read Darius-favoured at every stage while the page's own prose, its TRICKY / 7-10 difficulty rating and the packet's derived chart all say Kennen bullies the lane. champ-data/kennen.full.js CHAMP_FULL.kennen.darius carries the same wrong chart from the other side (Kennen rated 2/10 at level 1) and needs the inverse flip to Kennen 7/10, 6.5/10, 5/10, 6/10, 6/10, 5/10, 5/10 — mirror-fix.js should be run after this applies.
